items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1978-08-02
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Ciccatro played the clarinets. Hall played the baritone. Dink Taylor played the alto.

ctx.x: Ciccatro played the clarinets. Hall played the baritone. Dink Taylor played the alto. Mm-hmm.
